otherInstance.title: Another Yuzora owns the Companion
otherInstance.description: Another running Yuzora controls the Companion. Quit it and restart this Yuzora to manage the Companion here.

warning.title: Remote control of this computer
warning.description: Once enabled, an approved phone can operate AI Agents remotely. That is equivalent to granting shell access to this computer's account.

experimental.label: Companion (phone remote control)
experimental.description: Lets a paired phone on your tailnet view and, with a grant, control HERDR Agents. Turning this off stops a running Companion.

tailscale.title: Tailscale
tailscale.description: The Companion is reachable only through Tailscale Serve on your tailnet; it never listens on the network itself.
tailscale.install: Install Tailscale from tailscale.com/download and sign in with your personal account, then check again.
tailscale.otherPorts: Other Serve handlers on this hostname (ports {{ports}}) can read the Companion's cookies. Remove them if you do not trust them.
tailscale.certificateNote: HTTPS uses a certificate for this computer's tailnet name; the name is published in public Certificate Transparency logs.
tailscale.taggedNote: The phone must be signed in to the tailnet as a person: tagged devices carry no identity and cannot pair.

portState.foreground: Taken over by a foreground tailscale serve

refusal.notRunning: Tailscale is not running. Start it and connect to your tailnet.
refusal.noLogin: This computer is not signed in to a tailnet with MagicDNS. Sign in to Tailscale first.
refusal.tagged: This computer is a tagged device, so Serve sends no identity. Sign it in with a personal account.
refusal.httpsNotReady: HTTPS certificates are not enabled for this tailnet. Enable HTTPS in the Tailscale admin console (DNS page).
refusal.funnel: Tailscale Funnel is publishing something from this computer to the internet. Turn Funnel off first.
refusal.portTaken: The Companion port is already used by another Serve handler. Remove that handler or change the port.

leftover.title: A Serve handler may be left over
leftover.description: Yuzora applied a handler on {{host}}:{{port}} and has not confirmed it is gone.
leftover.elsewhere: The current Tailscale node is not the one the handler was applied on, so it cannot be removed from here.
leftover.forgetDescription: Yuzora will no longer look after the handler on {{host}}. If it is still there, run the command below on the node it was applied on to remove it.

enable.confirmDescription: Once the Companion is ready, Yuzora runs this command so your tailnet can reach it. Disabling or quitting Yuzora removes it again.

pairing.title: Pair a phone
pairing.description: Scan this code with the phone's camera. The phone then shows a code, and Yuzora asks you to approve the same code. A phone that is already paired does not need this: use Open on phone instead.

phoneLink.title: Open on a paired phone
phoneLink.description: On a phone that is already paired, scan this QR code or open this address, then log in with its passkey. No new pairing needed.
phoneLink.qrAlt: QR code for the Companion address
phoneLink.homeScreen: On iPhone, tap Share → Add to Home Screen in Safari; on Android, use Add to Home screen in the Chrome menu. Then open it from the home screen.

sessions.title: HERDR Sessions
sessions.description: Phones only see the selected local HERDR Sessions.
sessions.emptyAllowlist: No Session selected: phones see nothing.
sessions.restartRequired: The Companion is running: disable and enable it again to apply.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Phones registered with a passkey. Control lets a phone send input after confirming with its passkey.
devices.label: Device name
devices.revokeDescription: The phone is disconnected at once and has to pair again.

approval.title: Approve this phone?
approval.description: Approve only if the phone shows exactly this code.
approval.warning: An approved phone can register a passkey and view your Agents.

errors.companion-busy: The Companion is starting or stopping. Try again in a moment.
errors.companion-experimental-off: Turn on the Experimental Companion first.
errors.companion-other-instance: Another running Yuzora owns the Companion.
errors.companion-grants-mixed: Change one grant at a time.
errors.companion-label-invalid: Use a name of up to 80 bytes without leading or trailing spaces.
errors.companion-device-unknown: That device is no longer registered.
errors.companion-port-mismatch: The Companion listened on an unexpected port and was stopped.
errors.companion-session-invalid: That Session name is not valid.
errors.companion-start-timeout: The Companion did not start in time.
errors.companion-timeout: The Companion did not reply in time and was stopped.
errors.companion-store-corrupt: The Companion files are damaged; a backup was kept.
errors.companion-store-unreadable: The Companion files could not be read.
errors.companion-store-write-failed: The Companion files could not be saved.
errors.companion-tailscale-changed: Tailscale is signed in to another node or account than when the handler was applied. Switch back to remove it, or use Forget this record.
errors.companion-tailscale-remove-first: Remove the handler Yuzora applied earlier first. If its node is no longer reachable, use Forget this record.
errors.companion-tailscale-remove-instead: This record is for the current node: use Remove instead.
errors.companion-tailscale-unverified: Tailscale did not confirm the change.
errors.companion-unavailable: The Companion is not included in this build.
errors.companion-web-unavailable: The Companion web files are missing from this build.
errors.tailscale-timeout: Tailscale did not respond in time.
errors.tailscale-unavailable: The Tailscale CLI could not be started.

audit.stalled: A write from {{device}} to {{pane}} has stalled and may not be cleaned up yet.
audit.dropped: Some Companion audit records were lost ({{count}}).
audit.droppedTightening: Companion audit records about releasing or revoking control were lost ({{count}}). Check the devices in Settings.
